description: ATLAS M2 pre-registered protocol. Rolling-origin evaluation of the recursive 30-day forecasting procedure on legacy-v0: daily origins, expanding windows, refit at every origin with data through that origin only. Development period (selection) 2024-02-01..2025-05-31; embargo 2025-06-01..2025-06-29; confirmation period 2025-06-30..2026-05-31 (later, disjoint targets; never used to choose). The descriptive legacy_window period re-scores the legacy holdout days 2026-04-02..2026-06-30 at every horizon. Model specifications, selection rule, primary tests and sensitivity analyses were fixed before any run of this configuration.

origin_exclusions.label: legacy_identification_boundary
origin_exclusions.reason: Origins whose legacy design is affected by the leap-day step: trend, year and day of year are exactly collinear until 2025-01-01 (2025 targets not estimable from December 2024 origins), and afterwards the step is identified from very few 2025 rows (high leverage).

comparison_windows.label: legacy_holdout_window
comparison_windows.description: The 90 target days of the legacy one-step holdout, scored by every model at every horizon from the descriptive legacy_window origins (one refit per origin).
